messages:
nina (AE): heads-up: ClearVault ran their pilot stress test this morning and started seeing 429s + occasional 503s. security also asked for encryption-at-rest proof and an SSQ follow-up. can we triage?

kevin (SE): which API key/environment? any sample request IDs?

nina (AE): key cv-prod-test-91, window ~09:40-09:55 PT. sample id: cv_20260402_01. they did a ramp from 0->200 rps in 2m.

ops-bot: Canary rollout: finruntime-v2 deployed to node-group "pilot" at 2026-04-02T08:59:12Z.

alex (SRE): pulling logs for cv_20260402_01. gateway returned 429 on many requests; a few 503s show model worker OOM on node-3. looks like cold-start + large context caused memory spikes.

min (Runtime Eng): OOMs are concerning. what model / sequence length?

kevin (SE): customer used gptx-7b equivalent, avg context ~3k tokens, some calls with max_tokens 2500.

min (Runtime Eng): that's high. options: 1) ask them to reduce context / max_tokens during pilot, 2) enable lower-precision quantization path for the canary model to reduce memory, 3) spin up additional warm instances to serve their key.

alex (SRE): i can spin extra warm workers for the pilot key for 1 hour. prefer to avoid changing model binary mid-pilot.

kevin (SE): can we also temporarily relax per-key burst limits? their traffic pattern had a fast ramp.

alex (SRE): yes, can increase burst cap from 100->250 rps for key cv-prod-test-91. i'll monitor errors and cost.

ops-bot: Alert: node-3 memory >90% and restarted model process at 09:47:21Z.

min (Runtime Eng): restarted model process likely cleared OOM; i'll enable aggressive KV cache prefetch and reduce per-request KV retention for the canary.

kevin (SE): told ClearVault to run a second controlled ramp at 10:05 PT with reduced context to 800 tokens and max_tokens 512.

nina (AE): customer asked about Dedicated and if that would remove these warmup issues. they also want written confirmation of encryption-at-rest and key rotation cadence.

tara (SecOps): for hosted: we use managed KMS and AES-256 for disk encryption, keys rotate annually and on-demand. i'll prepare a short note and attach SOC2. if they want HSM-backed keys we can discuss Private deployment.

kevin (SE): customer confirms second run started 10:05. early metrics: error rate down to 0.5% vs 8% before. looks much better.

min (Runtime Eng): recommending longer warm pools for pilot customers with large contexts. i'll add a runtime flag to keep model instances 'warm' for keys marked POC for +30 minutes after activity.

alex (SRE): implemented burst increase and spun 4 extra warm workers at 09:55. watching memory and latency.

ops-bot: File uploaded: clearvault-pilot-logs-20260402.gz by kevin (SE) at 2026-04-02T10:20:03Z.

kevin (SE): logs attached show most 503s line up with node restarts. we've set up a short-term guardrail.

nina (AE): clearvault security wants the SSQ answers by EOD and a quote for Dedicated monthly reserve. sales-ops can we get pricing for a 4-week Dedicated trial?

kevin (SE): i'll capture sample telemetry and produce an ops note for sales-ops.

tara (SecOps): SSQ draft done, attaching internal link: https://redwood.internal/ssq/clearvault. will share once legal signs off on SOC2 export.

min (Runtime Eng): note for runbook: POC pattern = big contexts + rapid ramp -> KV cache warm + model memory pressure -> 429/503. mitigation checklist: reduce context, enable warm pool, increase burst cap, temporary worker scale-up, KV prefetch.

alex (SRE): planning to scale down extra warm workers at 14:00 PT unless customer requests extension.

nina (AE): thanks all. customer happy with mitigations and wants timeline for Dedicated pricing and SSQ delivery. i'll follow up with them and add their lead PM (read-only) to this channel.

kevin (SE): i'll attach the performance CSV and proposed Dedicated config after the final 30m of telemetry.

ops-bot: Note: incident marked resolved for ClearVault pilot spike at 2026-04-02T11:45:00Z.

nina (AE): closing the war-room. action items: tara send SSQ externally; sales-ops quote Dedicated trial; kevin share metrics + config; alex/ min revert warm workers at 14:00 PT unless extended.

kevin (SE): quick tip: requesters, ask for expected peak rps and sample context size up-front. saves the scramble.

nina (AE): agreed. closing thread in 1h unless someone flags follow-up. :white_check_mark:
